description: Na₄AgCl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Immm space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.78 Å) and two longer (2.79 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra, corners with four NaCl₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one AgCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eleven NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.78 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Ag¹⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form AgCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.78 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Ag-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Cl¹⁻ sites. In the first Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to six Na¹⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ag¹⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Ag₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the third Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ag¹⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Ag₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
